newsitem.title: USA: California Gov digs in on welfare reform plan.
newsitem.headline: California Gov digs in on welfare reform plan.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson dug in Wednesday to fight for his welfare reform proposals a day after Assembly Democrats gutted the plan.
"We are committed to the governor's plan," Wilson spokeswoman Lisa Kalustian said, adding the governor's proposals would not "be abandoned."

On Tuesday, the Democrat-controled Assembly Health and Human Services Committee cut out many key provisions of Wilson's welfare plan, including the governor's proposed time limits on welfare and work requirements.
Republican lawmakers blasted Democrats for their votes.
